scientific_scope_status: For arbitrary finite-dimensional quantum channels P,Q with the same input, the uniform conditional Umegaki relative-entropy order with constant c is equivalent to the complete equal-reference SLD metric order with the same c. Taking Q to be identity identifies the conditional Umegaki contraction coefficient with the complete equal-reference SLD coefficient. No equality with complete equal-reference Umegaki for arbitrary quantum channels follows. The N675 source contributes only its selected Section 2 saturated-reference filter; hardness and compiler claims remain unreviewed. Prior-art correction: Hirche, arXiv:2610.03706v1, Proposition 3.5 / Eq. (3.18), gives the coherent-qubit integral. The N966 conditional gauge and reverse filter are distinct and do not yield an equal-reference Umegaki witness by that integral alone.
